Order 40 cups of Bawang Tea's 'Bo Ya Jue Xian' in one go. Access over 50 government services on Alipay, including visas, household registration, and provident fund. On January 15, at the Qianwen product launch event, Qianwen officially announced its full integration with Alibaba ecosystem services such as Taobao, Alipay, Taobao Flash Sales, Fliggy, and Amap, rolling out over 400 new features at once, including ordering takeout, shopping, and booking flights. This Qianwen update may set a new paradigm for the commercial application of AI models.

Only after achieving scale did Alibaba begin to "discuss entry points." Looking back over the past year, the dominant form of C-end AI applications has largely remained confined to "solving problems within a dialog box."

items.title: Gambit, an open-source agent harness for building reliable AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN! Wanted to show our open source agent harness called Gambit. If you’re not familiar, agent harnesses are sort of like an operating system for an agent... they handle tool calling, planning, context window management, and don’t require as much developer orchestration. Normally you might see an agent orchestration framework pipeline like: compute -> compute -> compute -> LLM -> compute -> compute -> LLM we invert this so with an agent harness, it’s more like: LLM -> LLM -> LLM -> compute -> LLM -> LLM -> compute -> LLM Essentially you describe each agent in either a self contained markdown file, or as a typescript program. Your root agent can bring in other agents as needed, and we create a typesafe way for you to define the interfaces between those agents. We call these decks. Agents

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past decade, the market's vision of "AI assistants" has undergone three major rounds of expectation calibration. The first was with the launch of Siri, where voice control brought a novelty in interaction, leading people to believe that the intelligent butler Jarvis from movies was within reach, only to later realize it was often just a voice-activated alarm clock. The second came with the emergence of ChatGPT, whose fluent conversation and reasoning abilities made it seem like AI had finally gained a "brain," but the market soon recognized it as merely a sage confined to dialog boxes, unable to perceive the world beyond them. In early 2025, the arrival of Manus gave tangible reality to the concept of an Agent. This impact was unlike any before—many witnessed AI not only "talking" but also "doing." It opened browsers, wrote code, debugged errors, and even refreshed pages proactively when loading was too slow. As the hype around Manus gradually subsided following its acquisition, people realized that, regardless of technological changes, humanity's core desire for AI assistants has remained constant: users don't just want a chat companion that merely understands speech, nor do they only want a geek tool that writes code in a black-and-white interface; what everyone has always wanted is...
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos diez años, el mercado ha experimentado tres grandes ajustes de expectativas sobre la idea del "asistente de IA". La primera vez fue con el nacimiento de Siri, cuando el control por voz trajo una novedad en la interacción, haciendo creer que el mayordomo inteligente Jarvis de las películas estaba al alcance, pero pronto se descubrió que, en la mayoría de los casos, no era más que un despertador de voz. La segunda vez fue con la aparición de ChatGPT, cuya fluidez en la conversación y capacidad de razonamiento hicieron pensar que la IA finalmente tenía "cerebro", pero el mercado pronto se dio cuenta de que seguía siendo solo una inteligencia que debatía dentro de un cuadro de diálogo.
